text:
Ivy (AE): AuroraHealth POC kickoff. They want a 4h soak at 500 qps, ~1024-token outputs, p99 <220ms, errors <0.5%. Need sizing, run plan, and quick pricing + security checklist. Can SE/SRE scope?
Marcus (SE): On it. Two quicks: streaming % and estimated cacheable prompts?
Ivy (AE): 50% streaming, ~45% repeatable prompts.
Marcus (SE): Proposed test: warmup 20m, ramp 15m to 500 qps, 4h steady, 15m cooldown. Arrival: Poisson + scheduled microbursts: every 40m a 60s spike at 3x. Models to compare: rwd-13b-8k, rwd-13b-q4, rwd-7b-q8. KV prefix cache enabled. Suggest max_batch_delay 7ms for balance.
Marcus (SE): sample command:
```
rwd-load --model rwd-13b-q4 --target-qps 500 --duration 14700 --ramp 900 --warmup 1200 --burst-profile "40m:60s@3x" --concurrency 70 --payload-dist aurora_prompts.json
```
Ellen (SRE): Infra rec: Dedicated pool sized for 600 qps headroom. Autoscale min=1 max=3, cooldown 90s. Multi-AZ recommended. Pre-warm KV with a 10m cache-population pass before ramp. Fallback order -> 13b-q4 then 7b-q8.
Diego (Solutions): Pricing ballpark: Dedicated pool for rwd-13b-q4 ~ $1,000/hr to sustain 500 qps. 4h run + warmup ~= $4.6k. Multi-AZ + burst node add ~15%. Hosted token estimate ~ $0.20 per 1k inferred tokens (rough). I'll prepare two lines: baseline and burst-ready.
load-bot: quick smoke run:
```json
{"test":"aurora-smoke-2026-03-24","target_qps":500,"sustained_qps":502,"p50_ms":50,"p95_ms":140,"p99_ms":228,"error_rate_pct":0.3,"gpu_util_pct":84,"note":"p99 228ms >220ms. Try +15% capacity or lower batch_delay to 5ms."}
```
Marcus (SE): p99 228ms. Fastest mitigation: spin +15% capacity then validate 30m. If still high, drop max_batch_delay -> 5ms.
Ellen (SRE): I'll provision +15% now, schedule 30m validation. Also will enable KV pre-warm during ramp.
Diego (Solutions): Updating pricing to show delta for +15% capacity (~+$150/hr) and fallback to rwd-7b-q8. I'll attach redacted SOC answers to customer pack.
Ivy (AE): Acceptance criteria: sustained 500 qps x4h, p99 <220ms, errors <0.5%. If validation passes, schedule customer soak and demo. Thanks all :party_parrot:
